facts.text: Old Tbilisi is a short walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel is near Old Tbilisi, which means the city's most iconic and visited destination is just a short walk away.

facts.text: The hotel is situated in the city center.
facts.excerpt: Situated in the city center

facts.text: The hotel has welcomed locals and international travelers since 1991.
facts.excerpt: Since 1991, this Tbilisi, Georgia hotel has welcomed locals and international travelers with consistent quality.

facts.text: Many of the rooms and suites have private balconies, and they offer panoramic views of the historic skyline.
facts.excerpt: spacious rooms and suites, many with private balconies, offer panoramic views of the historic skyline

facts.text: The lobby design incorporates Georgian style and culture, from historic pattern weaves in the carpets to a Caravanserai courtyard.
facts.excerpt: Every detail of the design was thought out to incorporate Georgian style and culture, from the historic pattern weaves of the plush carpets to the Caravanserai courtyard

facts.text: Glass elevators ride up through the hotel's 10-story atrium.
facts.excerpt: Ride the glass elevators up with an expansive view of the 10-story atrium

facts.text: The hotel has panoramic views of the city and the Old Town.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel location brags stunning, panoramic views of the city and the Old Town.

facts.text: The hotel's views of Tbilisi overlook Narikala fortress and the Mtkvari River, with mountains around the city.
facts.excerpt: Spectacular views of Tbilisi, surrounded by mountains, overlooking Narikala fortress and river Mtkvari.

facts.text: The hotel is just minutes from Abanotubani, the ancient district of Tbilisi known for its sulphur baths.
facts.excerpt: We are located just minutes from Abanotubani, the ancient district of Tbilisi, Georgia, known for its Sulphur Baths.

facts.text: The hotel is just minutes from the Bridge of Peace, which connects Old Tbilisi with the new district.
facts.excerpt: We are located just minutes from the Bridge of Peace, which stretches 150 meters (490 ft) over the Mtkvari River, creating a contemporary design feature connecting Old Tbilisi with the new district.

facts.text: Metechi Bridge, at the foot of Narikala fort, is a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Metechi Bridge is located at the eastern bank of the Mtkvari River at the foot of Narikala fort across Metekhisubani, the historical part of Tbilisi, just 10 minutes walk from our hotel.

facts.text: The P'auza spa facilities include an indoor pool, plunge pool, grotto, ice pool, steam room and sauna, plus a spacious relaxation area.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy our indoor pool, plunge pool, grotto, ice pool, steam room, and sauna, as well as a spacious relaxation area.

facts.text: P'auza Spa uses Germaine de Capuccini products in its face and body treatments.
facts.excerpt: we use premium Germaine de Capuccini products in our face and body treatments

facts.text: The spa's Couple Luxury Suite experience pairs a couple's massage with time in a private jacuzzi with snacks and wine.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a romantic escape in our Couple Luxury Suite, featuring a 50 minutes couple’s massage followed by 30 minute in a private jacuzzi with snacks and wine.

facts.text: The spa's name draws on Tsutisopeli, which means life is just a minute, inviting guests to pause from the rush of life.
facts.excerpt: Tsutisopeli means life is just a minute. At p'auza, pause from the rush of life and nurture your wellbeing

facts.text: ATI is a rooftop restaurant, bar and lounge on the 10th floor serving modern interpretations of classic Georgian specialties with city views.
facts.excerpt: ATI is a rooftop restaurant, bar and lounge on the 10th floor, with idyllic city views and modern interpretations of classic Georgian specialties.

facts.text: The RTVELISI Brand Shop & Bar near the lobby offers tastings of Georgian wines, aged brandies and artisanal Chacha.
facts.excerpt: RTVELISI showcases the country’s finest wines, aged brandies, and artisanal Chacha

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a separate living room, dining room and lounge area with panoramic views of Old Tbilisi.
facts.excerpt: A separate living room, dining room, and lounge area reflect the look and feel of a modern penthouse apartment, enhanced by natural light and stunning, panoramic views of Old Tbilisi.

facts.text: The Royal Suite has a kitchen, a living space, a salon for private meetings or dining, and a balcony with a mountain view.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy an exceptional stay in our Royal Suite featuring a spacious bedroom with ensuite bathroom, living space, kitchen, salon for a private meeting or dining and enjoy a magnificent mountainous view right from your Royal Suite balcony.

facts.text: The Club lounge has a terrace with panoramic views over Old Tbilisi.
facts.excerpt: All-day snacks, happy hour, and panoramic views over Old Tbilisi, from Club lounge terrace.

facts.text: Guests can take part in a live khachapuri baking class during breakfast.
facts.excerpt: Guests can also take part in a live khachapuri baking class during breakfast

facts.text: The fitness center includes functional training rigs, squat racks and a boxing room.
facts.excerpt: Functional training rigs, squat racks Boxing room
